**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Render is not deterministic: `{call}` runs while rendering `{Component}`; move it into a keyed signal (its value is shipped) or a clientEffect
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Compute the value once into state the page ships (`const seed = signal(Math.random())` — the browser adopts the server value) or read it in a `clientEffect` / handler; `Date.now()`, `Math.random()`, `performance.now()`, `crypto.randomUUID()` / `getRandomValues()` and `new Date()` without arguments are reported in a boundary's render path.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function Stamp() {
  const n = signal(0);
  const t = Date.now();
  return <button onClick={() => n.set(t)}>{n()}</button>;
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function Stamp() {
  const n = signal(0);
  const t = signal(Date.now());
  return <button onClick={() => n.set(t())}>{n()}</button>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Resume modules (derived model, plan M2 C2). The browser derives an interactive component's structure by running its compiled DOM function over the server nodes (adopt run): the render must be a function of its props, keyed state and route data. A non-deterministic read outside keyed state would make the adopt run disagree with the markup. Handlers, effects, client events and other browser-only closures are not checked (they never run on the server). Error: the module does not compile under the derived model.
